texts.Permission:Plans.Manage: Create, edit, and confirm production plans
texts.ProductionDashboardSubtitle: An operational view of branch requests, cooking, dispatch, and waste today.
texts.ProductionAnalyticsSubtitle: Yield, waste, request fulfillment, and cost variance for the selected period.
texts.ProductionWasteSubtitle: A clear log of rejected or written-off kitchen quantities with reason and cost.
texts.ActionQueueSubtitle: Current priorities by production and request status.
texts.NoProductionData: There is not enough production data yet. Start with branch requests, then production plans.
texts.NoActionItems: There are no urgent actions right now.
texts.FormulasSubtitle: Define ingredients for each producible product with a clear deterministic planned-cost preview.
texts.NoIngredients: No ingredients yet. Add at least one ingredient to show the planned cost.
texts.SelectFinishedProductFirst: Choose a producible finished product first.
texts.PlannedCostHint: Deterministic preview for this formula output quantity. Ingredient cost uses the product cost price.
texts.ZeroCostWarning: One or more ingredients has a zero cost price, so the planned cost may be lower than reality.
texts.Error:Production:001: Output quantity must be an integer greater than zero.
texts.Error:Production:003: Expected waste percent must be between 0 and 100.
texts.Error:Production:004: Cost values must be zero or greater.
texts.Error:Production:005: Estimated production minutes must be zero or greater.
texts.Error:Production:006: Version number must be an integer greater than zero.
texts.Error:Production:007: Ingredient quantity must be an integer greater than zero in the base unit.
texts.Error:Production:008: Ingredient loss percent must be between 0 and 100.
texts.Error:Production:009: The same ingredient cannot be added to a formula twice.
texts.Error:Production:010: The requested formula item was not found.
texts.Error:Production:011: The finished product must be marked as producible.
texts.Error:Production:012: Ingredients must be raw materials, packaging, or semi-finished products.
texts.Error:Production:013: Planned production quantity must be an integer greater than zero.
texts.Error:Production:101: Quantity must be an integer greater than zero.
texts.Error:Production:102: The same product cannot be added twice.
texts.Error:Production:104: The request must contain at least one product before it can be submitted.
texts.Error:Production:105: The request cannot move to this status from its current status.
texts.Error:Production:106: A reason is required when approved quantity differs from requested quantity.
texts.Error:Production:108: Requested products must be active producible finished products.
texts.Error:Production:109: Kitchen requests can only be created for sales branches.
texts.Error:Production:111: Production plans must be for the main kitchen branch.
texts.Error:Production:113: Production plan line was not found.
texts.Error:Production:114: Override reason is required when planned quantity differs from the system suggestion.
texts.Error:Production:115: The plan must contain planned production quantity before it can be confirmed.
texts.Error:Production:116: The plan cannot move to this status from its current status.
texts.Error:Production:117: You can manage kitchen requests for your branch only.
texts.Error:Production:201: The cook order cannot move to this status from its current status.
texts.Error:Production:202: Cook order quantities must be integers greater than zero.
texts.Error:Production:203: Cook order ingredient was not found.
texts.Error:Production:204: An active default formula is required before creating a cook order.
texts.Error:Production:205: There are not enough ingredients to start cooking.
texts.Error:Production:206: Accepted quantity must be greater than zero before production can be completed.
texts.Error:Production:207: Waste reason is required when rejected quantity is greater than zero.
texts.Error:Production:208: A cook order already exists for this plan line.
texts.Error:Production:209: There is no planned quantity to convert into a cook order.
texts.Error:Production:210: Expiry date is required because the finished product has no shelf-life setting.
texts.Error:Production:211: A purchase order cannot be created for this ingredient because it has no default supplier. Open Products and set the default supplier for the raw material first.
texts.Error:Production:301: Waste quantity must be greater than zero.
texts.Error:Production:306: This product does not exist in the selected kitchen inventory.
texts.Error:Production:307: Waste quantity is greater than the available kitchen stock.
texts.MyKitchenRequestsSubtitle: Request finished products from the main kitchen and track approval and fulfillment.
texts.BranchRequestsSubtitle: Review sales branch requests, then approve quantities or reject them.
texts.ProductionPlansSubtitle: Turn approved branch requests, deterministic demand forecasts, and current kitchen stock into suggested production quantities.
texts.CreatePlanHint: Creates a draft from approved requests up to the selected date, weekday forecasts, and current kitchen stock.
texts.CookScreenSubtitle: Run kitchen orders, check ingredients, consume stock, and complete production batches.
texts.DispatchBoardSubtitle: Create branch transfers from completed kitchen production.
texts.IngredientPurchaseOrdersCreated: Created {0} draft ingredient purchase order(s) for a total shortage of {1}. Review them from Purchase Orders before approval and receipt.
texts.NoIngredientShortageToPurchase: There is no ingredient shortage that needs a purchase order right now.
texts.DispatchTransferCompleted: Transfer {0} is on its way — the branch confirms receipt on arrival. Quantity applied to branch requests: {1}.
texts.Notif:RequestsToApprove: {0} branch request(s) waiting for your approval
texts.CookHint:WaitingForIngredients: Ingredients are missing — receive or transfer in raw materials, then start cooking.
texts.CookHint:ReadyToCook: Everything is in stock. Press Start when you begin cooking — ingredients are deducted then.
texts.CookHint:InProduction: When the batch is done, press Complete and enter the accepted and rejected quantities.
texts.CookHint:Completed: Done — send the finished goods to a branch from the Dispatch board.
texts.RequestHint:ApproverSubmitted: Review the lines, then approve to create a cook order — or reject with a reason the branch will see.
texts.RequestHint:RequesterSubmitted: Sent — waiting for the kitchen to approve.
texts.RequestHint:RequesterDraft: Still a draft — press Submit to send it to the kitchen.
texts.RequestHint:Approved: Approved — the kitchen is producing it. You'll receive a stock transfer when it ships.
texts.RequestSavedFromDecision: Request {0} was created and linked to the decision log.
